question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summery: Mir Abdus Shukur Al Mahmud, born in 1936, was a Bangladeshi poet, novelist, and short story writer. He gained recognition in the 1950s with his work ‘Lok Lokantor’. Al Mahmud wrote numerous short stories, novels, and essays, including ‘Pankourir Rakto’ and ‘Upamohadesh’. He traveled to India in 1971 to promote the Liberation War. He received numerous awards, including the Ekushey Padak and the Kabi Jasim Uddin Award.
